Tessa / Laura — below is a tight negotiating position that balances risk and commerciality. I recommend we offer this as our counter and ask Nova to confirm acceptance to avoid prolonged back-and-forth.

Proposed new paragraph for Section X (Limitation of Liability / Exceptions):

"Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, the liability cap set forth in this Agreement shall not apply to Claims arising from the willful misappropriation of the other Party's trade secrets, provided that: (a) the claimant establishes by clear and convincing evidence that: (i) confidential information constituting a trade secret (as defined by the Uniform Trade Secrets Act) was accessed or exfiltrated; (ii) such access resulted from willful or reckless conduct by the other Party or its personnel; and (iii) the claimant provides a third-party forensic report, mutually acceptable to both Parties, documenting the exfiltration and chain of custody; (b) the claimant provides written notice and a 60-calendar-day cure period during which Parties will cooperate to contain damages; and (c) the total aggregate recovery in respect of such Claims shall be limited to the greater of $5,000,000 USD or two (2) times the total fees paid by Customer to Redwood under the relevant Order Form in the twelve (12) months prior to the date of discovery of the event."

Rationale and notes:
- Evidence threshold: insist on a mutually agreed forensic report to prevent speculative claims.
- Monetary boundary: $5M floor or multiple of fees keeps exposure finite while being meaningful for a biotech customer.
- Cure period & cooperation: reduces knee-jerk litigation and gives both sides a path to remediate quickly.
- Scope: carve-out is targeted to trade-secret misappropriation only; general confidentiality breaches that do not meet the trade-secret threshold remain subject to the standard cap.

Commercial levers we can offer (Laura):
- Temporary fee credit if Nova requires shortened cure period (e.g., 30 days) or accelerated access to forensics.
- Offer to connect via our cyber insurer for subrogation/coverage discussion if they press on unlimited exposure.

If this looks good, I can convert the language to a tracked redline and we can respond to Nova tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
